adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, after the refactor `bookingCalendarReference` is now an array and the code iterates `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. Inside the recurring-event branch (`if (bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent && bookingToDelete.recurringEventId && allRemainingBookings)`), it still builds `promises` by iterating over `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(..._calendar)` and then over `updatedBookings`, but for each `updBooking` it uses `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))` (only the first calendar ref). This means (1) that recurring deletions for the same `updatedBookings`/first `_calendar` reference set will be executed once per outer `reference` (duplicate deletes), and (2) additional `_calendar` references on each updated booking (e.g., other hosts/destinations) will not be deleted because `find` only returns one.
